title: An Empirical Evaluation of Message Delivery Reliability and Recovery Characteristics in Redis Streams and NATS JetStream
description: An auditable, computationally reproducible case study of specific recovery policies, concurrency behavior, and acknowledgment costs in Redis Streams 7.4.2 and NATS JetStream 2.10.24 under documented conditions in one homelab deployment. The artifact includes the manuscript, original timing observations and outcome records, deterministic analysis, configurations, historical and revised harnesses, selected conditional Lean results and verification receipts, and document QA. It supports descriptive comparisons and conditional model statements. It does not establish implementation correctness, equivalent durability contracts, tested power-loss durability, isolated synchronization-policy effects, or independent deployment-level replication.
